interventions.detail: Used Python 3.12 uv venv instead of Anaconda3/Python 3.5
CPU-only torch 2.5.1/torchvision 0.20.1 from the PyTorch CPU index instead of pytorch 0.4.0+cuda91
opencv-contrib-python-headless 4.10 (for cv2.ximgproc) instead of conda menpo opencv3; numpy<2.3
Skipped cupy, pynvrtc and scikit-umfpack (GPU-only / not needed with --fast --no_post)
apt install libgl1 libglib2.0-0 for OpenCV
smooth_filter.py: moved cupy/pynvrtc imports from module level into smooth_local_affine()
process_stylization.py: resize output back to original content size (in-place thumbnail bug); upsample->interpolate
